common.slogan: Scrap finds a buyer! Report illegal dumping!

home.heroDesc: GreenCity connects two vital environmental activities: selling recyclables at transparent published rates and reporting illegal dumping for community verification.
home.sellerDesc: Public price schedules for recyclable materials. Submit requests and receive transparent quotes from GreenCity.
home.buyerDesc: Browse inspected scrap lots on the online marketplace. Pass holders can directly reserve lots.
home.communityDesc: Submit photos of illegal dumping sites for admin verification, neighborhood cleanliness, and reward points.
home.processTitle: How a kilogram of scrap travels through five steps
home.processLede: A transparent process where reward points only award after transaction completion.
home.step1Desc: Clear price bands published for all material categories without price gouging.
home.step2Desc: Sellers select material types, attach photos, and request pickup.
home.step3Desc: GreenCity evaluates and responds with specific per-kg pricing.
home.step4Desc: Pickup team receives goods, verifies weight, and pays seller directly.
home.step5Desc: Reward points are added to your ledger upon transaction completion.
home.pointsCalcTitle: What is one reward point worth?
home.pointRateDesc: Calculated on actual payout received by seller, minimum 1 point per completed deal.
home.cleanupRewardDesc: Earned for every dumping report verified as genuine by administration.
home.pointsNotice1: Reward points are not cash and cannot be traded. The points ledger is append-only: there is no editable balance box, ensuring every point traces back to its verified action. Each action receives rewards exactly once.
home.pointsNotice2: Redeeming points for municipal public services is currently a proposal. Redemptions are not yet active.
home.ctaTitle: Building a cleaner, greener, and more sustainable city together
home.ctaDesc: Whether you are an individual seller, collection agent, or professional buyer, GreenCity creates a transparent recycling ecosystem.

auth.loginDesc: Sign in to manage sell requests, track purchases, and view your rewards ledger.
auth.registerDesc: Create a GreenCity account to sell recyclables, trade on the marketplace, or report dumping sites.
auth.signInRequiredDesc: You need to sign in to perform this action.
auth.signInRequiredBody1: Most of GreenCity needs an account: selling scrap, reserving listings, reporting dumping sites and viewing reward points. Only the homepage and the marketplace listings are visible without signing in.
auth.signInRequiredBody2: If you do not have an account yet you can register — it only needs an email, a password and a display name.

services.title: Services
services.lede: A system of green solutions connecting scrap sellers, collection units, and environmental protection communities.
services.sellDesc: Submit a request with a photo and an estimated weight, get a quote inside the published price band, then accept or decline it on the same page.
services.marketplaceDesc: Scrap lots an administrator has priced and published. Only one buyer can reserve each lot.
services.cleanupDesc: Submit a photo and a map pin for an illegal dumping site. An administrator checks and verifies it before the report counts.
services.rewardsDesc: Every completed sale and every verified report adds points to an append-only ledger, each traceable to the action that earned it.
services.catalogNote: This is what GreenCity does today. Nothing on this page is a paid package, and every entry carries the limit it currently has.
services.sellNote: GreenCity quotes within a published price band and publishes the listing. Pickup timing is arranged between the two parties; the system does not schedule collection.
services.marketplaceNote: Reserving requires an active Buyer Pass. payOS checkout has never been exercised against a real merchant account, so we cannot claim payment works.
services.cleanupNote: Reports are verified by an administrator and earn 50 points. Cleanup is carried out by local sanitation services; GreenCity does not coordinate that.
services.rewardsNote: The points ledger is real and awards automatically. The redemption coupons are contest prototypes: DEMO-ONLY codes are not valid anywhere and deduct no points.

recyclingBins.title: Recycling Bins
recyclingBins.lede: Recycling points in Ho Chi Minh City recorded by the OpenStreetMap community. Coverage is sparse and this is not an official city register.
recyclingBins.coverageBody: OpenStreetMap currently records {total} points inside the Ho Chi Minh City bounding box, {containers} of which are tagged as recycling containers. The rest are marked as recycling without saying what kind. This is community-contributed data and it is thin for a city this size — GreenCity shows exactly what exists and adds no points of its own.
